## Description

Rename or retire Role.SoloDoctor (RoleMatrix.cs, the web Role type, role matrix tests, about 52 files) so no individual-account concept remains, keeping the owner-doctor as an owner who is a doctor. Remove licencePending from the session, context and shell (SessionControl.cs, session.ts, App.tsx LicenceNotice). Rewrite copy that says Medvya verifies licences (onboarding.licence.notice, doctors.intro, invite.licence, inviteForm.licence, onboarding.team.doctors, staff.doctorNotice) in en, hi and ar. A change to a stored role value ships with a forward-only migration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the codebase, when searched for SoloDoctor or "solo doctor" in user-visible text, then nothing remains.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given an existing owner-doctor, when they sign in after the change, then access is unchanged.
- [ ] **AC3.** Copy in en, hi and ar says the owner attests licences and Medvya approves the organisation.
- [ ] **AC4.** Role matrix and permission tests pass; the ERD is regenerated if a table or column changes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
